content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have IR spectrum data: wavenumbers listed: 3109, 3107, 3086, 3081, 3048, 3037, 3033, 2991, 2978, 2954, 1588, 1577, 1502. No obvious carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. So likely zero carbonyl groups. However IR may miss if not present. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). But we have no carbon NMR yet. Could request carbon NMR to confirm. But IR lacking carbonyl stretch suggests none. To be safe, maybe get carbon NMR to verify. But cost: carbon NMR is cheap relative? Use tool. Let's get carbon NMR.
